description: Source code implementing RSA key parsing, serialization, and duplication functions for OpenSSL, including ASN.1 encoding/decoding.

methods.name: parse_integer
methods.description: Parses an ASN.1 encoded integer into a BIGNUM.

methods.name: marshal_integer
methods.description: Serializes a BIGNUM into ASN.1 format.

methods.name: RSA_parse_public_key
methods.description: Parses an RSA public key from ASN.1 data.

methods.name: RSA_public_key_from_bytes
methods.description: Creates an RSA public key object from DER-encoded bytes.

methods.name: RSA_marshal_public_key
methods.description: Serializes an RSA public key into ASN.1 format.

methods.name: RSA_public_key_to_bytes
methods.description: Serializes an RSA public key into DER bytes.

methods.name: RSA_parse_private_key
methods.description: Parses an RSA private key from ASN.1 data.

methods.name: RSA_private_key_from_bytes
methods.description: Creates an RSA private key object from DER-encoded bytes.

methods.name: RSA_marshal_private_key
methods.description: Serializes an RSA private key into ASN.1 format.

methods.name: RSA_private_key_to_bytes
methods.description: Serializes an RSA private key into DER bytes.

methods.name: i2d_RSAPublicKey
methods.description: Encodes RSA public key into DER format.

methods.name: i2d_RSAPrivateKey
methods.description: Encodes RSA private key into DER format.
